content.user_title: Write Social Posts in Your Voice
content.value_statement: Generic AI posts often sound polished but unlike the writer. This skill studies recent samples, drafts one social post, and checks it against the observed style.
actual_capabilities: Requests five recent self-written posts or four style questions.
Builds a concise sketch of openings, structure, vocabulary, register, and exclusions.
Shows the sketch before drafting so the user can correct it.
Drafts one Twitter or LinkedIn post against the approved sketch.
Reviews mismatches and performs one focused revision.
Supports optional VoiceMOAT profile, insight, publishing, and scheduling workflows.
limitations: Needs recent samples or detailed answers for personalized voice matching.
Does not represent a full writing history from five samples.
Does not provide numeric voice scores without the connected VoiceMOAT workflow.
Publishing and scheduling require a connected VoiceMOAT Pro or Enterprise account.

use_cases.title: Share Founder Insights
use_cases.description: Turn recent founder posts into a consistent LinkedIn draft about a product lesson or company decision.

use_cases.title: Prepare Marketing Updates
use_cases.description: Create a platform-ready post that follows a marketer's established tone, structure, and vocabulary.

use_cases.title: Explain Technical Work
use_cases.description: Draft a concise Twitter or LinkedIn post about an engineering decision while preserving the writer's style.

prompt_templates.title: Start With a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a LinkedIn post about [topic]. Ask me for five recent posts, then draft one post in the matching style.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Style Sketch
prompt_templates.prompt: Here are five posts I wrote: [samples]. Build a six-line sketch covering openings, structure, vocabulary, register, and words to avoid. Show it before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Draft and Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this approved sketch and write one Twitter post about [topic]. Check each sentence against the sketch, name mismatches, and revise once.

prompt_templates.title: Use Connected Data
prompt_templates.prompt: With my VoiceMOAT account, analyze my published posts, draft a post about [topic], show a preview, and ask for confirmation before publishing.

output_examples.input: Five short LinkedIn posts about product lessons, with direct openings and no hashtags.
output_examples.output:
We spent months adding features. The better question was what users needed every week.

That changed our roadmap. We removed three ideas and improved the one workflow customers already trusted.

output_examples.input: A request for a Twitter post about an engineering tradeoff, using a blunt and concise style.
output_examples.output:
Speed is useful. Rework is expensive.

We chose the smaller release, learned from real usage, and kept the next decision easier.

best_practices: Provide five ordinary recent posts written by you.
Approve the style sketch before requesting the draft.
Name uncertainty when a sample does not establish a clear pattern.
anti_patterns: Do not provide admired posts written by other people as voice samples.
Do not request a generic draft before sharing style evidence.
Do not treat a small sample as a complete voice profile.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Twitter and LinkedIn posts, threads, hooks, and rewrites.

faq.question: How many writing samples should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide five recent posts that you wrote yourself for the strongest style sketch.

faq.question: What if I have no writing samples?
faq.answer: Answer four style questions about your audience, openings, length, and avoided language.

faq.question: Does it create several drafts?
faq.answer: It creates one draft unless you request different opening options.

faq.question: Can it measure my writing style?
faq.answer: The manual workflow compares patterns without a numeric score. Connected VoiceMOAT can provide measurements.

faq.question: Can it publish posts for me?
faq.answer: Connected VoiceMOAT can publish or schedule posts after showing a preview and receiving confirmation.
